$comment: The approved-provider record for T0.1's archive probe. PROOF_STANDARD.md Version 3 §11 requires a
two-provider claim to use providers with DIFFERENT OPERATORS, checked against a machine-readable record.
2026-09-27: each provider carries its FIXED, PUBLIC, KEYLESS 'url', and the probe reads no URL from the
environment. Decided by Joshua after Codex diff review round 6 showed that a proof run still read
caller-supplied URLs for providers merely LABELLED keyless, so a key in a path or query could enter it.
A 'url' must be exactly https://<host>/ : root path, no query, no userinfo, no fragment. Credentialed
endpoints (Alchemy) are not in this record at all; they are checked by hand with
mako-design/scripts/check-alchemy-key.sh, which prints only HTTP status and never writes evidence.
Operators: QuickNode and Monad Foundation, from docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/testnet (read
2026-09-23). QuickNode's own service and testnet-rpc.monad.xyz are the SAME operator and must never be
paired. The Alchemy and dRPC records that stood here are in git history (before 2026-09-27).

providers.operatorEvidence: Monad's own testnet documentation names QuickNode as the provider for this endpoint, with archive supported: https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/testnet (read 2026-09-23). This endpoint is therefore NOT independent of a QuickNode account, and the two must never be counted as a pair.
providers.archiveSupport: Documented by Monad as archive-supported; measured deterministic to 43.6 days (8/8), refused at 50.8 days (0/8), 2026-09-22
providers.finalizedTag: supported, lag 3 to 4 blocks / 1 second measured 2026-09-22
providers.notes: Recorded as operator 'unknown' until 2026-09-23. That was an omission, not a limit of what is knowable: Monad publishes the operator. Correcting it turned an existing byte-identical agreement into a genuine two-operator pair.
providers.rateLimits: 50 rps, 25 rps for eth_call and eth_estimateGas; batch 100

providers.operatorEvidence: Monad's own testnet documentation names Monad Foundation as the provider for this endpoint, with archive supported: https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/testnet (read 2026-09-23). 'Monad Infra' is not a separate company; it is a Foundation property.
providers.archiveSupport: INTERMITTENT: measured 5/8, 6/8 and 1/8 at three historical blocks, 2026-09-22. Load balancer over backends with unequal pruning.
providers.finalizedTag: supported, lag 3 to 4 blocks / 1 second measured 2026-09-22
providers.notes: Agrees byte for byte with the QuickNode endpoint when it answers, including on the mandatory fixture at block 62922075. Measured INTERMITTENT at deeper blocks (5/8, 6/8, 1/8 at 23, 43.6 and 50.8 days, 2026-09-22), so a not-served answer here is ARCHIVE_UNAVAILABLE, never a verification failure. No key and no account required.

pairPolicy.twoDistinctOperators: Both providers must have a non-null 'operator' that is not 'unknown', and the two operators must differ. Only then may evidence carry proofLevel 'two-distinct-operators'.
pairPolicy.oneDomain: Any other pair. Evidence carries proofLevel 'one-domain', which PROOF_STANDARD.md Version 3 §1b states does not satisfy that section. A run invoked as proof exits non-zero with NOT_INDEPENDENT.
pairPolicy.hostCheck: Each provider's fixed 'url' must parse to exactly the recorded 'host', over https, with a root path and nothing else; the probe refuses any other shape before a request is sent.
